answer: Require each agent to forge a costly, verifiable work history before it can trade: new identities start with zero trust and must complete small, audited tasks whose outputs are checked by independent peers, earning reputation slowly like nectar gathered flower by flower. Only after sustained honest work does an agent gain access to the main wharf where high-value deals occur, and misbehavior burns its stake and history. Creating thousands of fake identities therefore costs far more in time, stake, and failed audits than any single fraud could repay.
